kai: Quick run — rack-packing sim across us-west / us-east / apac for L4 / T4 / A10G. Measured embeddings (batching) and small-chat (streaming). charts: https://grafana.redwood/xyz :chart_with_upwards_trend:

alex: Nice. Topline numbers (p50/p95 latency, tokens/s at steady state):
- L4 (small-chat): p50 22ms, p95 85ms, 140 tok/s
- T4 (small-chat): p50 35ms, p95 120ms, 105 tok/s
- A10G (small-chat): p50 18ms, p95 70ms, 170 tok/s
- L4 (embeddings batch=32): qps 380, p95 48ms
- T4 (embeddings batch=32): qps 460, p95 36ms
- A10G (embeddings): qps 410, p95 40ms

devon: Key caveat — kernel selection changed perf a lot. Using fused_mha-int8 on L4 gave p50 16ms but led to KV cache eviction thrash at high concurrency.

maria: Also saw quality diffs with q4f16 vs q8_0 on small-chat. q4f16 hallucinated on turn 3 for a subset of prompts (repro script: `eval_runs/qa_regress.sh --model small-chat.q4f16`). We should run the eval probe set overnight.

samir: For capacity sizing recs (very rough):
- small-chat: reserve 1 A10G per 40 rps steady-state (95th-oriented), or 1 L4 per 30 rps if using fused kernels but add 20% headroom.
- embeddings: T4 is most cost-effective for bulk batch workloads; plan 1 T4 per ~12k embed requests/day at batch=32.

bench-bot: Uploaded artifacts: s3://bench/rackpack/2222222222/ (csv + charts)

alex: Quick reproducible command I used:
```
bench --model small-chat.q4f16 --gpu A10G --batch 4 --seq 256 --concurrency 8 --report p50,p95,tokens/s
```

devon: follow-ups: 1) run the quant-eval on the probe set, 2) try fused_mha fallback on L4 to avoid KV thrash, 3) sanity-check A10G mem config (we saw +1GB vs baseline).

kai: OK assigning: @maria run quant-eval overnight, @devon try kernel fallback and post logs, @alex update the rackpack sim with per-rack cooling overhead (forgot thermal throttling). We'll sync tomorrow 10am PT. :thumbsup:
